te: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats the leaders of rival Japanese clans in the Battle of Sekigahara and becomes shōgun of Japan.
dz: 德川龙 义和团在濑原之战中击败了对立的日本部族首领并成为了日本的夏行.
de: Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats the leaders of rival Japanese clans in the Battle of Sekigahara and becomes shōgun of Japan.

t: 若昂·阿尔瓦雷斯·法贡德斯发现了圣皮埃尔岛和密克龙岛,赋予了它们"11000名圣母的岛屿"的原…
te: João Álvares Fagundes discovers the islands of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, bestowing on them their original name of "Isl…
dz: 若昂·阿尔瓦雷斯·法贡德斯发现了圣皮埃尔岛和密克龙岛,赋予了它们"11000名圣母的岛屿"的原名.
de: João Álvares Fagundes discovers the islands of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, bestowing on them their original name of "Islands of the 11,000 Virgins".

t: 马丁·路德加入维滕贝格大学神学院。
te: Martin Luther joins the theological faculty of the University of Wittenberg.
dz: 马丁·路德加入维滕贝格大学神学院。
de: Martin Luther joins the theological faculty of the University of Wittenberg.

t: 日本皇帝高棉山退位 支持竞争对手高棉.
te: Japanese Emperor Go-Kameyama abdicates in favor of rival claimant Go-Komatsu.
dz: 日本皇帝高棉山退位 支持竞争对手高棉.
de: Japanese Emperor Go-Kameyama abdicates in favor of rival claimant Go-Komatsu.

t: 教宗乌尔班三世去世后,选举出格里高利八世.
te: Election of Gregory VIII following the death of Pope Urban III.
dz: 教宗乌尔班三世去世后,选举出格里高利八世.
de: Election of Gregory VIII following the death of Pope Urban III.

t: 阿勒颇的阿塔贝格的曾吉从布利德王朝取出巴勒贝克.
te: Zengi, atabeg of Aleppo, takes Baalbek from the Burid dynasty.
dz: 阿勒颇的阿塔贝格的曾吉从布利德王朝取出巴勒贝克.
de: Zengi, atabeg of Aleppo, takes Baalbek from the Burid dynasty.

t: 由布永的戈弗雷、塔兰托的博希蒙德和图卢兹伯爵雷蒙德四世领导的十字军开始围攻安条克。
te: Crusaders led by Godfrey of Bouillon, Bohemund of Taranto, and Raymond IV, Count of Toulouse, begin the Siege of Antioc…
dz: 第一次十字军东征：由布永的戈弗雷、塔兰托的博希蒙德和图卢兹伯爵雷蒙德四世领导的十字军开始围攻安条克。
de: First Crusade: Crusaders led by Godfrey of Bouillon, Bohemund of Taranto, and Raymond IV, Count of Toulouse, begin the Siege of Antioch.

t: 一支塞尔柱克土耳其军队在西维托特战役中成功伏击了人民十字军.
te: A Seljuk Turkish army successfully ambushes the People's Crusade at the Battle of Civetot.
dz: 一支塞尔柱克土耳其军队在西维托特战役中成功伏击了人民十字军.
de: A Seljuk Turkish army successfully ambushes the People's Crusade at the Battle of Civetot.

t: 埃尔·希德和他的部队在克阿尔特战役中击败了阿尔莫拉维德人一支更大的军队.
te: El Cid and his forces defeat a larger army of the Almoravids in the battle of Cuarte.
dz: 埃尔·希德和他的部队在克阿尔特战役中击败了阿尔莫拉维德人一支更大的军队.
de: El Cid and his forces defeat a larger army of the Almoravids in the battle of Cuarte.

t: 教宗约翰五世去世后选举教宗康农.
te: Election of Pope Conon following the death of Pope John V.
dz: 教宗约翰五世去世后选举教宗康农.
de: Election of Pope Conon following the death of Pope John V.

t: 在被皇帝马克森提乌斯放逐到西西里后65天,教宗厄塞比乌斯去世.
te: Sixty-five days after being exiled by the Emperor Maxentius to Sicily, Pope Eusebius dies.
dz: 在被皇帝马克森提乌斯放逐到西西里后65天,教宗厄塞比乌斯去世.
de: Sixty-five days after being exiled by the Emperor Maxentius to Sicily, Pope Eusebius dies.
